# IRockets.Fired event

Raised on the game's thread when a use of the rockets fires its rocket, on the game of the runner who used it and on every game that learns of the use. Rockets fired with [`Fire`](./Fire.md) do not raise it.

```csharp
public event EventHandler<RocketFiredEventArgs>? Fired;
```
